evidence.quote: Spray forming is a single stage process with forming and consolidating the powders within the same chamber under a low vacuum pressure condition of 3 Pa. During spray forming, the molten stream was bottom poured from the remelting crucible through a graphite nozzle under a positive pressure of ~170 KPa, and fell freely onto a water-cooled copper disc rotating at up to 3000 rpm which was positioned 250 mm below the graphite nozzle.
the material used was γ-TiAl based intermetallic produced by IM and CSD, respectively.
